end.summary:
Practised showing 11–20 as one bundle of ten and loose ones.
Saanvi counted the bundle as one item when finding the total.
They worked with 10 and 3, then 10 and 4, but did not reach the total independently.
Teach-back was not passed; the lesson ended when Saanvi asked to stop.
end.parentNote: Saanvi practised making a bundle of ten and adding loose sticks. They used the physical sticks and repeated the number sequence, but the mix-up between “one bundle” and “ten” was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, try a small bundle of ten straws with 1–4 loose straws and ask, “How many altogether?” while saying, “one ten and some more.”
